policy.classification: Latest primary_sics_sector at or before 2023 from companies.csv
policy.allocation: One per eligible SICS sector; remaining 30-S slots by Hamilton largest remainders weighted by eligible sector count minus one; alphabetical ties
policy.eligibility: Known sector; at least one valid nonempty CSV metric in each source year 2015–2023 and at least one PDF with a valid header in each source year 2015–2022. Full PDF parsing is subsequently checked before acceptance. No task-specific metric, disclosure content or evaluator score gate.
policy.missing_policy: No imputation of absent metrics or evidence strata; retain missingness. Failed PDF parsing is recorded; if an entire required source year is unusable, use the next prespecified same-sector reserve and record the replacement before any generation. Never replace on evaluator scores.
